question: Does common positive scaling preserve the mature material player, so a learned ratio alone identifies its policy?
deduction: No scale invariance is promised by this Native search: fixed score margins214/17/155/SEE and +/-1 draw jitter coexist with variable leaf/native/capture prices. Uniform scale preserves ideal material minimax ordering below clipping, but can change selective search, aspiration and fixed-node completion. Source alone does not measure action changes or attribute them uniquely to a threshold. Next freeze same fullSession states and ratios at four unit scales, samego controls, exactACK and completelegal checks; no fitting/DEVselection/default alteration.
